name: Yukimoto Sakura
source: Tachibana's classmate and also a class president. Very silent and mysterious girl. This leads to some nasty false rumors about her, such as her engaging in prostitution and torturing animals. However, upon looking into her innermost thoughts, Kazuma sees that she’s even weirder than the rumor of her going up to the roof every day to imagine her dead body falling off it suggested.
